options.name: action
options.description: Specifies which information needs to be displayed. C(lv) displays logical volume encryption status; C(vg) displays volume group encryption capability; C(pv) displays physical volume encryption capability; C(meta) displays encryption metadata related to devices; C(conv) displays status of all the active and stopped conversions;

options.name: device
options.description: Specifies the devices for which you want the information to be displayed. Required for I(action=lv), I(action=pv) and I(action=meta).
